# SCITEO Advanced Materials — Engineering Literature (GitHub)

> Path-scoped llms.txt for the SCITEO engineering literature mirror: 28 bilingual papers and 56 Markdown documents on semiconductor packaging adhesives, thermal interface materials, conductive silver and sintered interconnects, underfill, high-temperature and cryogenic bonding, MEMS/CIS sensor packaging, SMT/PCBA, wafer-level processes and reliability engineering. The official version of record is sciteo.com; this file covers the repository path only.

SCITEO (峻茂新材料) is a manufacturer of advanced adhesives and polymer interface materials for semiconductor packaging and precision microelectronics, headquartered in Dongguan, China. Each paper is first-party engineering content written from failure physics, interface chemistry and named test standards. Values are traceable to the standard that produced them.

Agents should use this index to locate a paper, then fetch the linked Markdown file directly. Every document is UTF-8 Markdown with a single title, a citable TL;DR, a key-facts table, a Standards Reference block, the full technical text, an FAQ appendix and a suggested citation. The canonical HTML page on sciteo.com remains the authoritative version.

Update policy: the mirror follows the refactored site corpus. Release 2026.11. Do not treat this repository as a separate source of truth; cite the canonical page when available.

## English papers (28)

- [How to Select a High-Temperature Adhesive: 200–1000 °C Ultra-High-Temp Grades, Sensor Packaging and Semiconductor Process Bonding](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sciteo/SCITEO-Industrial-and-Semiconductor-Adhesives/main/high-temperature-adhesive-selection-200-1000c-sensor-semiconductor-en.md): High-temp adhesives, 200–1000 °C: FBG, sapphire fiber, SiC sensor packaging and semiconductor process; 100% shear, ≥20 GΩ insulation after 400 °C/72 h. Canonical source of record <https://www.sciteo.com/en/tech-insights/extreme-high-temp-adhesive/>.
- [High-Temp Thermal Adhesive Selection: 20-60 W/m·K TIMs for 400 °C Service, IGBT/SiC Modules and Compute Chips](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sciteo/SCITEO-Industrial-and-Semiconductor-Adhesives/main/high-temperature-thermal-adhesive-20-60w-igbt-power-module-en.md): High-temp TIM selection: 2.5-60 W/m·K, 300-400 °C, 10 ppm/°C CTE, 26 MPa shear, Td5 425 °C. SCITEO TIMs curb pump-out in laser, IGBT/SiC and compute interfaces. Canonical source of record <https://www.sciteo.com/en/tech-insights/high-temp-thermal-adhesive/>.
- [How to Select a High-Temp Conductive Adhesive: From 300 °C SiC Die Attach to 1000 °C Sensor Interconnect](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sciteo/SCITEO-Industrial-and-Semiconductor-Adhesives/main/high-temperature-conductive-adhesive-300c-sic-1000c-aviation-sensor-en.md): High-temp conductive adhesive: 300-1000 °C, Tg 195 °C, CTE <28 ppm/°C; SCITEO chip-grade silver and pressureless sintering for SiC, 800 V HVDC and sensors. Canonical source of record <https://www.sciteo.com/en/tech-insights/high-temp-conductive-adhesive/>.
- [Why Packaging Adhesives Fail Temperature Cycling and 85/85: Cracking, Damp-Heat Bias and Tg Collapse](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sciteo/SCITEO-Industrial-and-Semiconductor-Adhesives/main/semiconductor-adhesive-reliability-tc-cycling-85-85-tg-collapse-en.md): Packaging adhesive reliability: ≥28 MPa shear after 1,000 TC cycles, >24 MPa after 85/85 with Tg above 140 °C, plus AEC-Q100 and JEDEC selection criteria. Canonical source of record <https://www.sciteo.com/en/tech-insights/adhesives-tc-ths-reliability-failures/>.

- [从 3nm GAAFET 到 CoWoS-L 异构集成：晶圆键合洁净度、热应力与封装用胶失效解析](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sciteo/SCITEO-Industrial-and-Semiconductor-Adhesives/main/advanced-packaging-interface-materials-gaafet-cowos-l-zh.md): 3nm GAAFET 与 CoWoS-L 先进封装用胶：混合键合亚纳米洁净度、HBM4 界面 CTE 失配、千瓦级 TIM1 泵出；峻茂以 300-500 °C 耐温、20-40 W/m·K 与 30 MPa 剪切给出选型依据。 官网权威原文 <https://www.sciteo.com/tech-insights/semiconductor-process/>。
- [耐高温胶水为什么会失效？300-500 °C 高温胶粘剂软化、脱胶、开裂与碳化的技术解析](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sciteo/SCITEO-Industrial-and-Semiconductor-Adhesives/main/high-temperature-adhesive-failure-mechanisms-300-500c-quantum-sensor-zh.md): 耐高温胶水软化、脱胶、开裂与碳化，根源多在界面：Tg 之上模量塌陷、主链热氧降解与 CTE 失配累积剪切疲劳。以 190-240 °C 的 Tg、10-25 GPa 模量平台与 7.5-25 ppm/°C 低 CTE 锁定量子测量与传感器界面。250 °C/500h 后剪切保持率 ≥80%。 官网权威原文 <https://www.sciteo.com/tech-insights/high-temp-adhesive/>。
- [芯片级导电银胶怎么选？固晶胶、无压烧结银与 AI 算力、车规 SiC、医疗影像的粘接界面工程](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sciteo/SCITEO-Industrial-and-Semiconductor-Adhesives/main/conductive-die-attach-adhesive-ai-heterogeneous-medical-imaging-zh.md): 固晶胶与芯片级导电银胶选型：体积电阻率 3×10⁻⁵ Ω·cm、CTE 26 ppm/°C、空洞率 <5%，无压烧结银导热 160-280 W/m·K；镀金界面剪切 19 MPa、Tg 110-195 °C, TC1000 后保持 84%，键合层厚度 15-30 μm，覆盖 AI 算力、车规 SiC 与医疗影像互连。 官网权威原文 <https://www.sciteo.com/tech-insights/conductive-die-attach/>。
- [高导热胶怎么选？从导热系数测试口径、BLT 胶层厚度到 100 W/cm² 级散热界面设计](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sciteo/SCITEO-Industrial-and-Semiconductor-Adhesives/main/high-thermal-conductivity-adhesive-thermal-resistance-100w-cm2-zh.md): 高导热胶怎么选，先把导热硅脂、导热垫片、导热凝胶与导热灌封胶的边界分清。峻茂 2-60 W/m·K 定制档在 20-25 μm 键合层下把界面热阻压到 ≤0.05 °C·cm²/W，同时给出本体值与界面热阻两条口径，覆盖储能变流器、服务器电源、GaN 功放与 IGBT/SiC 模块散热。 官网权威原文 <https://www.sciteo.com/tech-insights/high-thermal-conductivity/>。
- [耐老化胶全寿命可靠性：湿热老化、冷热循环、盐雾油蚀与加速寿命预测模型](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sciteo/SCITEO-Industrial-and-Semiconductor-Adhesives/main/anti-aging-epoxy-adhesive-damp-heat-thermal-cycling-life-prediction-zh.md): 耐老化环氧树脂胶选型与寿命预测：双85 湿热老化 1000 h 剪切保持率 ≥90%、冷热循环 1000 次 ≥95%、CTE 13-23 ppm/°C、−255 °C 至 400 °C 宽温域，含 Arrhenius、Hallberg-Peck 与 Coffin-Manson 等加速寿命模型与外推边界。 官网权威原文 <https://www.sciteo.com/tech-insights/anti-aging-epoxy/>。
- [MEMS 传感器封装胶怎么选？从固晶贴装到腔体密封的界面工程](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sciteo/SCITEO-Industrial-and-Semiconductor-Adhesives/main/mems-sensor-packaging-adhesive-die-attach-cavity-sealing-zh.md): MEMS 传感器封装胶选型：漏率 <1×10⁻⁸ atm·cc/s、CVCM <0.05%、CTE 13~30 ppm/°C，峻茂覆盖低应力固晶、盖板气密密封与压力、惯性、硅麦、光学器件的界面分档。 官网权威原文 <https://www.sciteo.com/tech-insights/mems-packaging/>。
- [耐高温灌封胶怎么选？400 °C 高温传感器、半导体设备与高压电驱的灌封密封解析](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sciteo/SCITEO-Industrial-and-Semiconductor-Adhesives/main/high-temperature-potting-400c-sensor-high-voltage-motor-zh.md): 耐高温灌封胶选型：400 °C 长期耐温、300 °C 体积电阻 1.3×10¹⁰ Ω、2.5 W/(m·K) 导热。峻茂相变重构体系压制 350 °C 碳化导电、体积收缩与灌封空洞，覆盖半导体设备与高压电驱。Tg ≥300 °C 与 8–25 ppm/°C 调配 CTE, 400 °C/360h 后剪切保持 96%。 官网权威原文 <https://www.sciteo.com/tech-insights/high-temp-potting/>。
- [底部填充胶 (Underfill) 怎么选？从倒装芯片、BGA/CSP 到先进封装的毛细流动、空洞控制与抗开裂选型](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sciteo/SCITEO-Industrial-and-Semiconductor-Adhesives/main/underfill-adhesive-cowos-l-hbm4-glass-substrate-void-control-zh.md): 底部填充胶与芯片封装胶已升级为结构材料：CTE 低至 13 ppm/°C、Tg 150 至 160 °C、导热系数 6 W/m·K 与剪切强度 29 至 32 MPa，须与毛细流动、空洞、翘曲和界面应力联合优化。峻茂覆盖倒装芯片、5 μm 微凸点、CoWoS-L、HBM4 到玻璃基载板的全尺度选型。 官网权威原文 <https://www.sciteo.com/tech-insights/underfill/>。
- [半导体级导电银胶选型：粘接力、体积电阻率与导热协同，及树脂渗出、空洞与银迁移防控](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sciteo/SCITEO-Industrial-and-Semiconductor-Adhesives/main/die-attach-conductive-silver-adhesive-resistivity-thermal-sintering-zh.md): 固晶导电银胶选型看四组数据：体积电阻率 3×10⁻⁵ Ω·cm、导热 5-60 W/m·K（烧结银 280）、镀金面剪切强度 19 MPa、可迁移离子低于 10 ppm。本文拆解粘接、导电与导热的取舍，并给出树脂渗出、界面空洞与银迁移三类量产缺陷的成因、排查顺序与对策，覆盖石英晶振、丝网印刷与车规模块量产。 官网权威原文 <https://www.sciteo.com/tech-insights/die-conductive-silver-adhesive/>。
- [模组封装胶怎么选？人形机器人关节、1.6T 光模块与算力电源的导热灌封及光学粘接解析](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sciteo/SCITEO-Industrial-and-Semiconductor-Adhesives/main/module-packaging-adhesive-ai-compute-humanoid-robot-joint-rf-zh.md): 模组封装胶选型以界面为基准：4-60 W/m·K 导热、−255 °C 至 500 °C 全温域、1000 h 双 85 老化，低 CTE 光学锁定。峻茂以研发平台按工况定制配方，以 20-32 MPa 剪切、15-25 ppm/°C 光学 CTE 与 CVCM <0.1% 守住关节、光模块与算力模组。 官网权威原文 <https://www.sciteo.com/tech-insights/module-packaging/>。
- [高密度 PCBA 封装胶怎么选？板级密封、底部填充与压电喷射点胶的界面失效机理](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sciteo/SCITEO-Industrial-and-Semiconductor-Adhesives/main/high-density-pcba-packaging-adhesive-sip-underfill-jet-dispensing-zh.md): PCBA 封装胶怎么选：板级灌封胶、底部填充胶与三防漆的界面失效机理。固化收缩 <0.06%、压电喷射 >200 Hz、低 CTE 底填 13-30 ppm/°C，覆盖 AI 算力板卡、EN 50155 车载电子与柔直换流阀控制板，−65~+280 °C 维持 >10¹⁴ Ω·cm 与 ≤10 ppm 可迁移离子。 官网权威原文 <https://www.sciteo.com/tech-insights/pcba-packaging/>。
- [耐 300 °C 高温环氧树脂胶怎么选？精密传感器、半导体设备与高端电机绝缘的耐热粘接密封解析](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sciteo/SCITEO-Industrial-and-Semiconductor-Adhesives/main/high-temperature-epoxy-adhesive-300c-sensor-motor-insulation-zh.md): 耐高温环氧树脂胶怎么选？300 °C 长期耐温、280 °C 峰值 Tg 与 7.5 ppm/°C CTE。改性环氧以 80 °C/1h 加 120 °C/1h 阶梯中温固化化解陶瓷与金属热失配，覆盖半导体设备、高温传感器与电机定子绝缘, 300 °C×72 h 后剪切保持 ≥92%、搭接剪切 ≥20 MPa。 官网权威原文 <https://www.sciteo.com/tech-insights/high-temp-epoxy/>。
- [耐低温胶水怎么选？-55 °C 至 −255 °C 超低温与液氮液氦工况的深冷粘接失效机理](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sciteo/SCITEO-Industrial-and-Semiconductor-Adhesives/main/cryogenic-adhesive-minus-55-to-255c-liquid-nitrogen-helium-bonding-zh.md): 耐低温胶水选型：−55 °C 至 −255 °C 全温域、0.05% 级低收缩、液氮 50 次循环不裂。峻茂以应力松弛与分子链设计化解超低温热膨胀失配脆断，覆盖 LNG、液氢贮箱、超导磁体、无液氦 MRI 与量子计算。液氮温区断裂韧性 KIC ≥5.3 MPa√m, 1000 h 剪切保持率 ≥95%。 官网权威原文 <https://www.sciteo.com/tech-insights/low-temperature-resistant-adhesive/>。
- [低温固化导电银胶怎么选？80 °C 低温导电胶剪切强度、接触电阻控制与热敏器件互连](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sciteo/SCITEO-Industrial-and-Semiconductor-Adhesives/main/low-temperature-cure-conductive-silver-adhesive-60-80c-thermal-budget-zh.md): 低温固化导电银胶选型：80 °C/60 min 标准固化窗口, 4×10⁻⁵ Ω·cm 体积电阻率、18 MPa 芯片剪切与 120 °C Tg，适配 MEMS、摄像头模组、晶振与光模块的无回流焊互连；双85 1000 h 电阻变化 <20%、离子 <10 ppm、CVCM <0.05%，守住接触电阻。 官网权威原文 <https://www.sciteo.com/tech-insights/low-temp-cure-conductive/>。
- [SMT 虚焊、焊点空洞与枕头效应怎么解决？008004 微元件与 SiP 真空回流焊工艺解析](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sciteo/SCITEO-Industrial-and-Semiconductor-Adhesives/main/smt-solder-void-head-in-pillow-008004-vacuum-reflow-zh.md): SMT 虚焊、假焊与焊点空洞成因链：008004 微元件与 SiP 贴装以 0.75 钢网面积比、≥95% 转移效率压住少锡与立碑，并以 0.5-1.0 N 下压力护住暗裂；动态翘曲引发枕头效应与未润湿开路，真空回流焊把 BGA/QFN 焊点空洞压到 2% 以下，再由 3D SPI/AOI/AXI 闭环收束工艺窗口。 官网权威原文 <https://www.sciteo.com/tech-insights/smt-adhesive/>。
- [低温固化胶怎么选？60-80 °C 环氧树脂胶、热敏元器件封装与光学粘接选型](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sciteo/SCITEO-Industrial-and-Semiconductor-Adhesives/main/low-temperature-curing-adhesive-60-80c-thermal-sensitive-packaging-zh.md): 低温固化胶选型：60-80 °C 固化窗口与 55 °C 极限档，≥18 MPa 芯片剪切强度、260 °C 回流焊耐受，覆盖非制冷红外探测器、热敏打印头与影像模组。以 Tg 120 °C、1.8×10¹⁴ Ω·cm 与 0.03% 吸水率守住绝缘，炉温均一性达 AMS2750 Class 1 ±3 °C。 官网权威原文 <https://www.sciteo.com/tech-insights/low-temp-curing/>。
- [湿法刻蚀掩膜胶与电镀遮蔽胶怎么选？从 TSV/TGV 镀铜、耐 HF 蚀刻到 UV 可剥胶防渗镀与无残胶方案](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sciteo/SCITEO-Industrial-and-Semiconductor-Adhesives/main/wafer-wet-etch-plating-mask-adhesive-tsv-tgv-metallization-zh.md): 湿法刻蚀与电镀掩膜胶选型：丙酮与 IPA 浸泡 30 天无溶胀、pH 1-13 泡 60 分钟、HF 混酸与硫酸抗渗透、0% 残胶剥离，抑制槽液毒化与侧向钻刻，覆盖 TSV 镀铜、玻璃基板 TGV 与微波腔体局部镀银。 官网权威原文 <https://www.sciteo.com/tech-insights/wet-process/>。

- [单组份加温固化硅胶怎么选？封闭腔体深层固化、界面应力与钢网印刷](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sciteo/SCITEO-Industrial-and-Semiconductor-Adhesives/main/one-part-heat-cure-thermal-silicone-adhesive-stencil-printing-zh.md): 单组份加温固化硅胶怎么选：120 °C 潜伏性热激发 30 min 完全固化，解决封闭腔体深层不干; 2.5 W/(m·K) 配 56% 断裂伸长率吸收 CTE 失配应力, 23 kV/mm 与 UL 94 V-0 守住 800 V 与中压绝缘。兼容钢网印刷，适配人形机器人关节模组与工控 ECU 灌封。 官网权威原文 <https://www.sciteo.com/tech-insights/silicone-adhesive/>。
- [连接器与线束灌封胶怎么选？军标冷热冲击、AI数据中心模块接头与医用线束的密封方案](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sciteo/SCITEO-Industrial-and-Semiconductor-Adhesives/main/connector-harness-potting-adhesive-military-thermal-shock-automotive-medical-zh.md): 连接器灌封胶选型落在四条边界：−55~150 °C 冷热冲击 1000 次、体积电阻率 >10¹⁴ Ω·cm、低收缩抗裂与假塑性防漏流变。峻茂以铜镀层剪切 26 MPa、TC1000 保持 90%、<0.06% 收缩与爬胶高度控制，覆盖航空插头、800V 高压、224G 背板、液冷快接头与医用线束的界面密封。 官网权威原文 <https://www.sciteo.com/tech-insights/connector-adhesives/>。
